description: This file declares the interface for the position sensor hardware layer related to trigger input, including functions to turn on trigger input pins and apply new trigger input configurations.

methods.name: turnOnTriggerInputPins
methods.description: Initializes or activates the trigger input pins, accepting a shared logger for logging operations.

methods.name: applyNewTriggerInputPins
methods.description: Applies or updates the configuration of trigger input pins.
